global_rule: Any FAIL, BLOCKED, INVALID, NOT_RUN or NOT_AUTHORIZED forbids GO.
environment_rule: An unavailable route, browser, dependency, dataset, access, authorization or mismatched SHA is not PASS; it must be reported as BLOCKED/INVALID or NOT_RUN/NOT_AUTHORIZED with the mapped exit code.

objectives.name: provenance-architecture-packaging
objectives.target: local HEAD equals remote HEAD on the required 40-hex SHA; theme/style.css and theme/assets/css/style.css exist; unzip -t returns 0; two clean package builds have identical SHA-256
objectives.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git ls-remote; scripts/package-deterministic-v1.7.1.sh
objectives.pass_rule: All equality, presence, integrity and byte-identical rebuild assertions are true.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Missing checkout, remote, package or build input => exit 2 and BLOCKED/INVALID.

objectives.name: php-syntax
objectives.target: 100% of tracked PHP files in theme, partikulier-core and mu-plugins pass php -l; failed=0
objectives.command: find theme partikulier-core mu-plugins -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
objectives.pass_rule: tested>0 and failed=0.
objectives.environment_block_rule: PHP or source manifest unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: javascript-syntax
objectives.target: 100% of JavaScript files in the declared build scope pass node --check; failed=0
objectives.command: node --check for every JS/MJS file in the declared manifest
objectives.pass_rule: Manifest is complete and failed=0.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Node or manifest unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: static-security
objectives.target: Semgrep scans the declared PHP scope with 0 blocking findings and 0 scan errors
objectives.command: semgrep --config <pinned-ruleset> --json --output semgrep.json <declared-scope>
objectives.pass_rule: results=0, errors=0 and no undocumented global exclusion.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Semgrep/ruleset unavailable or scan truncated => exit 2.

objectives.name: repository-secrets
objectives.target: 0 high-confidence operational secrets: private keys, API tokens, passwords, real cookies or SQL dumps
objectives.command: pinned secret scanner over tracked commit and declared history scope
objectives.pass_rule: No unallowlisted high-confidence secret match.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Scanner, commit or history scope unavailable => exit 2; never request real secrets.

objectives.name: public-rest-ajax-headers
objectives.target: 10/10 declared anonymous requests return their exact expected statuses; every declared write without auth/nonce returns 401 or 403; no sensitive data leaks
objectives.command: pinned HTTP matrix runner against the declared base URL
objectives.pass_rule: All 10 cases match status/body/header assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Base URL, declared route or response provenance unavailable => exit 2; 404 is not protection.

objectives.name: estatik-data-and-filters
objectives.target: Fixture 249 with media 250 is the only declared synthetic fixture; a-vendre includes exactly 1 fixture, a-louer includes 0, unknown action includes 0; type+city+action preserves city, image, badge, price and specs
objectives.command: read-only HTTP/HTML assertions against the declared fixture dataset
objectives.pass_rule: All inclusion, exclusion and field-preservation assertions are exact.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Fixture, media, IDs or canonical dataset unavailable => exit 2; no new fixture without explicit authorization.

objectives.name: arabic-localization-jsonld
objectives.target: 6/6 AR views have lang=ar, dir=rtl, at least one visible Arabic text, parseable JSON-LD and 0 forbidden French residue
objectives.command: browser/HTTP locale matrix over the six declared AR views
objectives.pass_rule: All 6 views satisfy every assertion.
objectives.environment_block_rule: AR route, JSON-LD or locale data unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: ui-ux-responsive-cross-browser
objectives.target: 30/30 scenarios in each of Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; 90/90 HTTP/locale/direction, 90/90 image DOM, 90/90 link crawl and 96/96 responsive layouts
objectives.command: scripts/test-ui-v1.8.mjs for chromium, firefox and webkit with pinned contract
objectives.pass_rule: All counters equal their targets and no scenario is ERROR.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Any required browser, route or dependency unavailable => exit 2; do not substitute Chromium.

objectives.name: automated-accessibility
objectives.target: 6/6 FR/EN/AR desktop/mobile views; 0 axe violations, 0 serious/critical violations, 0 unlabeled controls and 0 images without alt
objectives.command: scripts/test-accessibility.mjs
objectives.pass_rule: passed=6, failed=0 and every violation/control counter is zero.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Axe, browser or route unavailable => exit 2; manual WCAG review remains separate.

objectives.name: immediate-filter-click
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: click after domcontentloaded opens panel with aria-hidden=false, is-open and aria-expanded=true
objectives.command: targeted Playwright simulation with no artificial wait before click
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy all state assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Required browser or route unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: post-javascript-filter-click
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: readyState=complete, main.js observed HTTP 200, and panel state is open and coherent
objectives.command: targeted Playwright simulation after load and main.js response
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy all readiness and state assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: main.js, browser or route unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: close-button
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: close button leaves aria-hidden=true, no is-open class and closed backdrop
objectives.command: targeted Playwright open/click-close simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers close correctly.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Panel or close button unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: escape-focus
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: Escape closes panel and focus returns to filter toggle within 500ms
objectives.command: targeted Playwright keyboard simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy close and focus deadline.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Keyboard, browser or panel unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: filter-city-autocomplete
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: query Marr returns HTTP 200 and at least 1 suggestion; selection sets non-empty hidden city value; no write request
objectives.command: targeted Playwright autocomplete simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy all five assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Nonce test data, AJAX endpoint or city seed unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: main-search-autocomplete
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: query Marr returns HTTP 200 and selection sets #pk-s-city-value non-empty
objectives.command: targeted Playwright main-search autocomplete simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy every assertion.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Main search field or AJAX endpoint unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: type-city-cumulative-filter
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: at least 1 type option; selected type and city survive submit; final HTTP 200 URL contains both es_type and es_city
objectives.command: targeted Playwright type+city no-write simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers preserve both parameters and return HTTP 200.
objectives.environment_block_rule: No localized type term, missing seed or route 404 => exit 2, not a silent PASS.

objectives.name: reset-after-filter
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: reset ends at exact /fr/annonces/ path, empty query string and HTTP 200
objectives.command: targeted Playwright filter/reset simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy path, query and status assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Reset link or route unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: arabic-structured-data
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: AR RTL view, visible Arabic text, parseable JSON-LD and 0 forbidden French residue
objectives.command: targeted Playwright AR/JSON-LD simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy all assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: AR route or JSON-LD unavailable => exit 2.

objectives.name: nonce-auth-reflection
objectives.target: 3/3 browsers: AJAX without nonce and anonymous write return 401/403; script payload is not reflected; no sensitive response data
objectives.command: targeted Playwright/request security simulation
objectives.pass_rule: All 3 browsers satisfy all four assertions.
objectives.environment_block_rule: Declared endpoint or base URL unavailable => exit 2; no real credentials.
